title: The Web in the Meadow
intro: This quiz follows Nina and Eli as they learn how food chains connect to form food webs in an ecosystem.

questions.prompt: Where do many food chains begin?
questions.explanation: Many food chains begin with plants.

questions.prompt: Which food chain did Ms. Romero draw in the dirt?
questions.explanation: Ms. Romero drew: grass → grasshopper → frog → snake → hawk.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between a food chain and a food web?
choices: A food chain includes plants, but a food web does not
A food chain shows one path, while a food web shows many connected paths
A food web contains only animals
A food chain is always longer than a food web
questions.explanation: A food chain shows one path, while a food web shows many connected paths.

choices: They make their own food using sunlight
They eat insects and small animals
questions.explanation: Plants are called producers because they make their own food using sunlight.

questions.prompt: What do decomposers such as fungi and bacteria do?
choices: Break down dead living things and return nutrients to the soil
questions.explanation: Decomposers such as fungi and bacteria break down dead living things and return nutrients to the soil.
